name: California Club Sandwich with Lemony Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until it is golden brown and cooked through and bacon until it is crispy, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels and pat dry the bacon.
Wash and dry spinach. Wash and slice tomato into rounds. Halve and pit avocado; cut into slices while still in skin and scoop out.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 tomato
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together mayo with ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad dressing).
In a small bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spread garlic mayo over the bottom halves of bread in each pair. Layer with spinach leaves, chicken, avocado, tomato, and bacon. Top with remaining slices of bread.
Place sandwich on a plate and serve with remaining spinach on the side. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
